checks: Garage quotes include the car, engine and new parts; failed purchases are atomic and repeated installation is free
Legacy migration retains the installed setup once; later saves and forged build descriptors cannot unlock unpaid parts
Only completed close passes earn points; duplicate traffic IDs are cooled down and an objective pays once
Drift points remain bankable on the dock while city objectives, delivery timers and police payouts stay in the city
Distance counts plausible motion, rejects teleport jumps and invalid states, and recovery cancels the active job
Delivery pickup, cargo damage, payment and persisted jobs survive normal play without duplicate rewards
Pursuit rewards require a real pursuit interval and clean-run collisions reset the active streak
Road routes follow the actual curved graph and do not cut across neighbouring streets or blocks
Directed unreachable routes stay absent and navigator arrivals cannot leak into a new waypoint or world
Map projection round-trips across viewports and headings, and vehicle forward and compass north use the same axes
Real CPU canvas renders circular clipping, player orientation, rotating north, district labels and surface polygons
limits: Map checks execute the real Canvas 2D renderer on a CPU canvas. They do not verify browser layout, GPU rendering or physical controller navigation.
Progression is local to the browser save. It is not an anti-cheat or server-backed economy.
